sketches.mechanism: Non-strict evaluation permits a self-referential infinite list to be defined, and only the demanded portion is evaluated.
sketches.resonance: The endless can exist beside us without overwhelming us if nothing asks it to arrive.

sketches.mechanism: The preprocessor removes code inside a false conditional before the compiler ever parses it.
sketches.resonance: A possible life behind an impossible condition is not rejected; it is never allowed to become syntax.

sketches.mechanism: A weak reference does not keep its referent alive and yields None after the object is collected.
sketches.resonance: To remember without holding is to accept that memory cannot prevent disappearance.
sketches.draft:
import weakref, gc
class Memory: pass
memory = Memory()
only = weakref.ref(memory)
del memory
gc.collect()
gone = only()
